source_cards.objective: Explain how checksum audit detects altered archived bytes.

source_cards.label: calendar sharding
source_cards.description: Calendar sharding partitions event records by month, routes each event to its month partition, and searches all intersecting month partitions for a date interval.
source_cards.objective: Explain how calendar sharding searches a date interval.

source_cards.label: escrow counter
source_cards.description: An escrow counter assigns each replica a spending allowance, rejects decrements above the local allowance, and transfers allowance between replicas without changing the global total.
source_cards.objective: Explain how an escrow counter prevents excess decrements.

source_cards.label: prefix compression
source_cards.description: Prefix compression stores the common beginning of sorted keys once, records the remaining suffix for each key, and reconstructs each key by joining its prefix and suffix.
source_cards.objective: Explain how prefix compression reconstructs a key.
